crossRefs.note: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…
He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your…
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to…
casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

translations.web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
translations.bsb: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
translations.kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
translations.asv: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.
